changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment: The column binding a user row to its login was named after Keycloak, and Keycloak is gone. What it holds is the subject (the sub claim) the configured auth provider puts on its tokens, so it is renamed for that. The values are not migrated: a subject is only meaningful to the provider that issued it, so rows written under Keycloak no longer match anyone and an environment moving providers starts its users afresh.
changeSet.sql: ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS uk_users_keycloak_id RENAME TO uk_users_auth_subject
ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS idx_users_keycloak_id RENAME TO idx_users_auth_subject
